subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier note about driving validated conversions for {Brand} in the US, where the install on its own tells you almost nothing about the subscriber. The one point worth repeating: we optimize MAFO toward the trial start that survives to a paid, billed subscription, read back through an S2S postback off your MMP before it counts, so a started trial only credits once it converts to paid. At scale that holds near 1,400 validated conversions a day (illustrative). Worth a short look at the cohort view?
register_notes: Stage 1 EN education: references the prior cold email in the first sentence; restates the single parent proof (validated conversion = trial-to-paid surviving to billed, S2S postback via MMP); one illustrative MobUpps figure (1,400 validated conversions/day); soft CTA, exactly one question mark; native English, no sign-off, no em-dash, no X-not-Y.
